create_cache_instance: create a Cache instance to store in-memory API responses for financial data
build_get_cache: build a call to get_cache to retrieve the global Cache singleton instance
test_set_prices: test set_prices to append new price data to the cache for a given ticker
review_get_financial_metrics: review get_financial_metrics to retrieve cached financial metrics for a ticker
summarize_merge_data: summarize _merge_data to deduplicate and merge new data into existing cached lists
